The national visitor-facing risks are compounded by removed state protections, a bar on stronger local ordinances, and school facility restrictions that expressly cover visitors. Youth-care bans add to the hostile institutional climate.

National risks are compounded by school facility restrictions, constrained identity documents, a youth-care ban, absent state protections, and a hostile high-court ruling. The dated killing near the general homicide rate does not establish a campaign.

Extensive operating protections, a visitor-relevant shield, and gender-neutral bathrooms substantially improve local conditions. National border, document, facility, and custody exposures still apply; one county’s sports restriction is a limited countervailing signal.
